title.english: The Cart to the West Gate

pairs.target: dào le dìwǔrì , lín zhào néng fú zhe chuángyán zhàn yíhuìer le .
pairs.english: By the fifth day, Lin Zhao could stand for a while holding the edge of the bed.
pairs.hanzi: 到了第五日，林照能扶着床沿站一会儿了。

pairs.target: xié shì dài niángzǐ cóng chuángdǐ lāo chūlái de .
pairs.english: Mistress Dai had fished the shoes out from under the bed.
pairs.hanzi: 鞋是戴娘子从床底捞出来的。

pairs.target: hǎo jiǎo shēnjìnqù , yì cǎi jiù dàodǐ , zhǒng zhe de nà zhī què kǎ zài xié kǒu .
pairs.english: Her good foot slipped all the way in at one push, but the swollen one caught at the opening.
pairs.hanzi: 好脚伸进去，一踩就到底，肿着的那只却卡在鞋口。

pairs.target: lín zhào dītóu qù gòu xiédài , yāo shàng lìkè yì jǐn , zhǐhǎo sōngshǒu .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao bent her head to reach for the laces, but her waist tightened at once and she had to let go.
pairs.hanzi: 林照低头去够鞋带，腰上立刻一紧，只好松手。

pairs.target: " gěi wǒ . "
pairs.english: “Give it here,”
pairs.hanzi: “给我。”

pairs.target: dài niángzǐ dūnxiàlái , bǎ xiédài wǎnghuí chōu le liǎng kǒng ,
pairs.english: Mistress Dai said, crouching to pull the laces back through two eyelets.
pairs.hanzi: 戴娘子蹲下来，把鞋带往回抽了两孔，

pairs.target: " sōng xiē yě néng chuān .
pairs.english: “You can wear it looser too.
pairs.hanzi: “松些也能穿。

pairs.target: bié cǎi zhe dàizǐ . "
pairs.english: Mind you don't tread on the laces.”
pairs.hanzi: 别踩着带子。”

pairs.target: xié chuān shàng le , jiǎobèi réng zhàng dé nánshòu .
pairs.english: The shoes were on, but the swelling across her instep still hurt.
pairs.hanzi: 鞋穿上了，脚背仍涨得难受。

pairs.target: lín zhào shì zhe wǎngqián nuó le yíbù , shǒu shùnzhe chuángyán huáguòqù , mō dào le jìntóu .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao tried one step forward, her hand sliding along the bed until it found the end.
pairs.hanzi: 林照试着往前挪了一步，手顺着床沿滑过去，摸到了尽头。

pairs.target: zài wǎngqián jiù zhǐ shèng yíkuài kòngdì , lí mén hái yuǎn .
pairs.english: Beyond it there was only a stretch of open floor, still far from the door.
pairs.hanzi: 再往前就只剩一块空地，离门还远。

pairs.target: tā zhànzhù , tīngjiàn wàitou yǒurén dào dòuzǐ .
pairs.english: She stopped and heard someone pouring beans outside.
pairs.hanzi: 她站住，听见外头有人倒豆子。

pairs.target: nà shēngyīn huālā yíxià , suíjí yǒurén mà lòu le dài dǐ .
pairs.english: There was a sudden rush of sound, followed at once by someone cursing the hole in the sack's bottom.
pairs.hanzi: 那声音哗啦一下，随即有人骂漏了袋底。

pairs.target: děng rén bǎ sǎ de dòuzǐ sǎo lǒng , tā hái zài yuándì .
pairs.english: By the time they swept the spilled beans together, she still was in the same spot.
pairs.hanzi: 等人把撒的豆子扫拢，她还在原地。

pairs.target: dài niángzǐ līn le tiáo ǎidèng guòlái .
pairs.english: Mistress Dai brought over a low stool.
pairs.hanzi: 戴娘子拎了条矮凳过来。

pairs.target: " zuò ba .
pairs.english: “Sit down.
pairs.hanzi: “坐吧。

pairs.target: méi rén gēn nǐ qiǎng mén . "
pairs.english: Nobody's racing you to the door.”
pairs.hanzi: 没人跟你抢门。”

pairs.target: lín zhào zuòxià cái fājué , tuǐ yìzhí zài dǒu .
pairs.english: Only when she sat did Lin Zhao realize her legs had been shaking the whole time.
pairs.hanzi: 林照坐下才发觉，腿一直在抖。

pairs.target: wǔhòu , sòng zhōu de niánqīngrén lái shōu wǎn .
pairs.english: In the afternoon the young man who brought gruel came to collect the bowls.
pairs.hanzi: 午后，送粥的年轻人来收碗。

pairs.target: lín zhào wèn tā , wàitou de chē dōu shàng nǎér qù .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao asked him where the carts outside were all headed.
pairs.hanzi: 林照问他，外头的车都上哪儿去。

pairs.target: " zhòng chē dào hébiān xiè shítou .
pairs.english: “The loaded carts go down to the river to unload stone.
pairs.hanzi: “重车到河边卸石头。

pairs.target: jìn lì jīn de shì sòng zhàng de chē , gé liǎngtiān yítàng . "
pairs.english: It's the cart carrying the accounts that goes into Lijin, one trip every two days.”
pairs.hanzi: 进砾津的是送账的车，隔两天一趟。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ kōng wǎn luò qǐlái ,
pairs.english: He stacked the empty bowls.
pairs.hanzi: 他把空碗摞起来，

pairs.target: " nǐ xiǎng tuōrén shāohuà ? "
pairs.english: “Do you want to ask someone to take a message?”
pairs.hanzi: “你想托人捎话？”

pairs.target: lín zhào běnlái zhǐ xiǎng wènlù , tīng tā yì shuō , dǎo zhēn xiǎng le piànkè .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao had only meant to ask the way, but what he said made her consider it for a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 林照本来只想问路，听他一说，倒真想了片刻。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn ruò zhīdào tā zài zhèlǐ , kǒngpà lián shōugōng dōu děngbùjí .
pairs.english: If Aunt Zhou knew she was here, she probably wouldn't even wait to finish work.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶若知道她在这里，恐怕连收工都等不及。

pairs.target: tā huì lái , lùshang shuōbúdìng háiyào mǎi liǎngzhī rè bǐng , pà tā zài pénglǐ méi chī gòu .
pairs.english: She would come, and might buy two hot flatbreads along the way for fear Lin Zhao hadn't eaten enough at the shed.
pairs.hanzi: 她会来，路上说不定还要买两只热饼，怕她在棚里没吃够。

pairs.target: " nà chē cóng nǎbiān jìnchéng ? "
pairs.english: “Which way does that cart enter town?”
pairs.hanzi: “那车从哪边进城？”

pairs.target: " xīmén .
pairs.english: “The west gate.
pairs.hanzi: “西门。

pairs.target: nǐ yào shāohuà , wǒ zhīdào gǎnchē de shì shuí . "
pairs.english: If you want a message sent, I know who's driving.”
pairs.hanzi: 你要捎话，我知道赶车的是谁。”

pairs.target: tā niē zhe xiùkǒu , méi jiē zhè jù huà .
pairs.english: She pinched her cuff and left the offer unanswered.
pairs.hanzi: 她捏着袖口，没接这句话。

pairs.target: niánqīngrén děng búdào xiàwén , dītóu kàn le kàn wǎndǐ , duān zǒu le .
pairs.english: When no answer came, the young man glanced down at the bottoms of the bowls and carried them away.
pairs.hanzi: 年轻人等不到下文，低头看了看碗底，端走了。

alignment.english: at the bottoms of the bowls

pairs.target: bàngwǎn huàn bù , dài niángzǐ wèn tā jīntiān zǒu le jǐbù .
pairs.english: At the evening dressing change, Mistress Dai asked how many steps she had taken that day.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚换布，戴娘子问她今天走了几步。

pairs.target: " yíbù . "
pairs.english: “One step.”
pairs.hanzi: “一步。”

pairs.target: " míngtiān zǒu liǎngbù . "
pairs.english: “Take two tomorrow.”
pairs.hanzi: “明天走两步。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán háiyào qù kàn lìng yìchuáng shāng le shǒu de shígōng , līn pén shí bèi ménbiān de zhúkuāng bàn le yíxià , shùnjiǎo bǎ kuāng tī dào le qiánggēn .
pairs.english: After saying that, she had another patient to see, a stoneworker with an injured hand, and as she lifted the basin she tripped once on the bamboo basket by the door and kicked the basket against the wall with her foot.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完还要去看另一床伤了手的石工，拎盆时被门边的竹筐绊了一下，顺脚把筐踢到了墙根。

pairs.target: lín zhào wàng zhe kōng chūlái de ménkǒu , suànlesuàn cóng chuángbiān dào nàlǐ de bùshù .
pairs.english: Looking at the cleared doorway, Lin Zhao counted the steps it would take to get there from the bed.
pairs.hanzi: 林照望着空出来的门口，算了算从床边到那里的步数。

pairs.target: dìliùrì , tā zǒu dào le ménkǎn .
pairs.english: On the sixth day, she made it to the threshold.
pairs.hanzi: 第六日，她走到了门槛。

pairs.target: yuànlǐ shài zhe liǎngpái shī wéiqún .
pairs.english: Two rows of wet aprons were drying in the yard.
pairs.hanzi: 院里晒着两排湿围裙。

pairs.target: shígōng zuòzài yīnliángchù , zhèng yòng hǎoshǒu bāi yíkuài bǐng ,
pairs.english: The stoneworker sat in the shade, trying with his good hand to break a flatbread.
pairs.hanzi: 石工坐在阴凉处，正用好手掰一块饼，

pairs.target: bāi le liǎnghuí méi bāikāi , suǒxìng ná yá yǎo .
pairs.english: He tried twice without breaking it and gave up and bit into it with his teeth instead.
pairs.hanzi: 掰了两回没掰开，索性拿牙咬。

pairs.target: tā jiàn lín zhào wǎng wài zhāngwàng , cháo jiǎomén biān yì yáng xiàbā .
pairs.english: Seeing Lin Zhao peering outside, he raised his chin toward the side gate.
pairs.hanzi: 他见林照往外张望，朝角门边一扬下巴。

pairs.target: " kàn chē ?
pairs.english: “Looking for the cart?
pairs.hanzi: “看车？

pairs.target: nà liàng míngzǎo jìnchéng . "
pairs.english: That one's going into town tomorrow morning.”
pairs.hanzi: 那辆明早进城。”

pairs.target: jiǎomén biān tíng zhe liàng ǎi chē , chēshàng zhǐyǒu liǎngzhī mùxiāng .
pairs.english: A low cart stood by the side gate with just two wooden boxes on it.
pairs.hanzi: 角门边停着辆矮车，车上只有两只木箱。

pairs.target: chēfū dūn zài yìpáng xiū tídēng , dēngzhào xièxiàlái , gē zài jiǎo biān .
pairs.english: The driver crouched off to one side repairing a lantern, its cover removed and set beside his feet.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫蹲在一旁修提灯，灯罩卸下来，搁在脚边。

pairs.target: lín zhào fú zhe ménkuàng jiào le tā yìshēng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao held the doorframe and called to him once.
pairs.hanzi: 林照扶着门框叫了他一声。

pairs.target: chēfū táiqǐ tóu .
pairs.english: The driver raised his head.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫抬起头。

pairs.target: " dào xīmén néngdài wǒ yìchéng me ? "
pairs.english: “Could you take me as far as the west gate?”
pairs.hanzi: “到西门能带我一程么？”

pairs.target: " zuò dé zhù jiù shànglái .
pairs.english: “Climb aboard if you can sit upright.
pairs.hanzi: “坐得住就上来。

pairs.target: tiānliàng qián zǒu , wǒ bù děng rén . "
pairs.english: I leave before dawn, and I wait for nobody.”
pairs.hanzi: 天亮前走，我不等人。”

pairs.target: tā shuō zhe yòu dīxiàtóu , bǎ wāi le de tóng kòu àn huí cáo lǐ .
pairs.english: Speaking, he lowered his head again and pressed the bent copper catch back into its slot.
pairs.hanzi: 他说着又低下头，把歪了的铜扣按回槽里。

pairs.target: lín zhào hái méi láidejí dàoxiè , tā yǐjīng tí zhe dēng qù le lìngyìtóu .
pairs.english: Before Lin Zhao could thank him, he'd already taken the lantern to the other end of the yard.
pairs.hanzi: 林照还没来得及道谢，他已经提着灯去了另一头。

alignment.english: the other end of the yard

pairs.target: nàtiān yèlǐ , dài niángzǐ zhàojiù lái huàn bù .
pairs.english: That night Mistress Dai came to change the dressing as usual.
pairs.hanzi: 那天夜里，戴娘子照旧来换布。

pairs.target: lín zhào bǎ jìnchéng de shì shuō le .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao told her about her plans for going into town.
pairs.hanzi: 林照把进城的事说了。

pairs.target: dài niángzǐ shǒushàng tíng le tíng , wèn tā xià le chē yǒuméiyǒu rén jiē .
pairs.english: Mistress Dai's hands paused, and she asked whether anyone would meet her when she got off the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 戴娘子手上停了停，问她下了车有没有人接。

pairs.target: " wǒ rènde lù . "
pairs.english: “I know the way.”
pairs.hanzi: “我认得路。”

pairs.target: " wǒ wèn de shì rén . "
pairs.english: “I asked about people.”
pairs.hanzi: “我问的是人。”

pairs.target: lín zhàokàn zhe tā shǒushàng nà juàn gānjìng de bù , méi shuō zhōu shěn de míngzì .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao looked at the roll of clean cloth in her hands and kept Aunt Zhou's name to herself.
pairs.hanzi: 林照看着她手上那卷干净的布，没说周婶的名字。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ cái jìn péng shí , lián bēishuǐ dōu duān búzhù .
pairs.english: She remembered how she couldn't even hold a cup of water when she had first come to the shed.
pairs.hanzi: 她想起自己才进棚时，连杯水都端不住。

pairs.target: dài niángzǐ yě méi cuī tā , zhǐ bǎ bù shōujǐn yìxiē , děng tā tǔ wán nà kǒuqì .
pairs.english: Mistress Dai didn't press her either, only tightened the cloth a little and waited for her to let that breath out.
pairs.hanzi: 戴娘子也没催她，只把布收紧一些，等她吐完那口气。

pairs.target: " dào le chénglǐ , zhǎo gèrén tì nǐ kànkàn shāng . "
pairs.english: “Once you're in town, get someone to look at that wound for you.”
pairs.hanzi: “到了城里，找个人替你看看伤。”

pairs.target: lín zhào diǎntóu .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao nodded.
pairs.hanzi: 林照点头。

pairs.target: zhèhuí tā bǎ huà tīng jìnqù le .
pairs.english: This time she took the words to heart.
pairs.hanzi: 这回她把话听进去了。

pairs.target: tiān méi liàng , tā bǎ qìzhǐ cóng zhěn xià mōchūlái , réngjiù shōu zài yī lǐ .
pairs.english: Before dawn, she felt for the contract under her pillow and tucked it inside her clothes again.
pairs.hanzi: 天没亮，她把契纸从枕下摸出来，仍旧收在衣里。

pairs.target: yāodài hé shuǐnáng līn zài shǒushàng , xiédài dǎ dé hěn sōng ,
pairs.english: She had the pouch and waterskin in hand, and her laces were loosely tied.
pairs.hanzi: 腰袋和水囊拎在手上，鞋带打得很松，

pairs.target: tā zài chuángbiān zuò zhe , bǎ chuí zhe de liǎngjié sāijìn xié biān .
pairs.english: Sitting on the bed's edge, she tucked the two trailing ends into the sides of her shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 她在床边坐着，把垂着的两截塞进鞋边。

pairs.target: jiǎomén yǐjīng kāi le .
pairs.english: The side gate was already open.
pairs.hanzi: 角门已经开了。

pairs.target: chēfū zài chē páng děng shēngkǒu yǐnshuǐ ,
pairs.english: The driver stood by the cart waiting for the draft animal to drink.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫在车旁等牲口饮水，

pairs.target: qiáojiàn tā , shēnshǒu bǎ jìnchù nà zhī xiāngzǐ wǎng lǐ tuī le tuī .
pairs.english: When he spotted her he reached out and pushed the nearer box farther in.
pairs.hanzi: 瞧见她，伸手把近处那只箱子往里推了推。

pairs.target: lín zhào xiān bǎ yāodài hé shuǐnáng fàng shàngchē , cái fú zhe chē bǎn zuòshàngqù .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao put the pouch and waterskin aboard first, then braced herself on the cart bed and sat down.
pairs.hanzi: 林照先把腰袋和水囊放上车，才扶着车板坐上去。

pairs.target: yuànlǐ hái méi liàng wéiqún ,
pairs.english: The aprons hadn't yet been hung in the yard.
pairs.hanzi: 院里还没晾围裙，

pairs.target: tīkāi de zhúkuāng kàozhe qiáng , kōng zhe de ménkǒu tòuchū yìdiǎn dēngguāng .
pairs.english: The basket that had been kicked aside stood against the wall, and a little lamplight showed through the empty doorway.
pairs.hanzi: 踢开的竹筐靠着墙，空着的门口透出一点灯光。

pairs.target: tā kàn le yíhuìer , tīngjiàn chēfū bǎ shuǐtǒng tí kāi , biàn jiāng zìjǐ de jiǎo yě wǎng lǐ shōu le shōu .
pairs.english: She watched for a while, and when she heard the driver lift the water bucket away, she drew her feet in a little too.
pairs.hanzi: 她看了一会儿，听见车夫把水桶提开，便将自己的脚也往里收了收。
